Welcome to Happy Tower! Get ready to climb, and conquer the ultimate Happy Tower! Challenge yourself and your friends in a colorful world full of tricky obstacles. 

Don't forget to give a like!

Developed by @qowy (Wiko) & @leflameL

Inspired by HAP HAP TOWER 2 made by @Noonaaigo, Down Tower made by @Bebiyaks, and Collapsing Tower made by @Twi_1st Games
